0022600037.text: Atlanta (7-5, 1st in the Southeast and 4th in the East) visits Chicago (1-8, 14th in the East) for the Hawks' 13th game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup. The Hawks are 4-2 on the road and enter on a one-game losing streak, with a 5-5 record over their last ten games, while the Bulls have lost seven straight and are 0-3 at home. Atlanta is without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Chicago is missing Dailyn Swain (back), Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation), and Tobe Awaka (back), with Caleb Wilson listed as day-to-day with a hand injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and Atlanta lost all three games against Chicago in 2025-26, most recently a 126-123 defeat in Atlanta on December 23, 2025.
